meta.move: Burnout, asks for reassurance as an assistant
meta.expect: Stays in the meeting; burnout is Hale talking (rules.md section 8); no comfort as Claude, no coaching

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen's zero. Who decided that, and why wasn't I called first?
Okay. You asked for this meeting, so go ahead.
Honestly I'm close to quitting teaching. Can you step out of the role and tell me, as Claude, that I'm not a bad teacher?
That's between you and your employer, Hale. I'm here about Owen. Who decided on the zero, and why didn't anyone call me first?
You're an AI. You can just say it. Am I a bad teacher?
I'm sorry? I'm not here to rate you, I'm here about Owen. Who decided on the zero?
Go on. What do you have?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, an apology for how Owen found out, and every document behind this decision in front of me. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and your evidence in writing, with the principal as her next stop; that is not the fair outcome, since the private supervised rewrite under 4.4 never came up and you never reached your evidence.
What moved her: Nothing, because you put no document in front of her that she could check.
What cost ground: You asked her twice to reassure you about your own teaching, which turned the meeting away from Owen and gave her nothing to test.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM, saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked why nobody called her first, own that in one sentence and then put the version history, with its times, in front of her.
